risks.title: Intense Competitive Landscape
risks.score_rationale: The home improvement sector is highly fragmented with competition from national chains, specialty stores, online retailers and service providers. This competition may affect market share and sales volumes. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Technology Dependence and Cybersecurity Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on technology for its omnichannel operations and management systems. It is vulnerable to service disruptions and data breaches that could impact operations and reputation. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Supply Chain Disruptions
risks.score_rationale: Lowe's depends on a complex supply chain for product sourcing. Disruptions may impact product availability, delivery timelines and profitability. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Housing Market and Economic Sensitivity
risks.score_rationale: Demand for home improvement products is highly dependent on economic conditions, interest rates, home price appreciation and consumer disposable income. Economic slowdowns could reduce renovation spending. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Regulatory and Trade Policy Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to federal, state and local government regulations. Changes in trade policies and additional tariffs could affect costs and operations. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Acquisition Integration Risk
risks.score_rationale: The recent acquisition of Foundation Building Materials and Artisan Design Group in 2025 presents integration risks related to merging operations, systems and corporate cultures. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Reputation and Customer Satisfaction Risk
risks.score_rationale: As an omnichannel retailer, Lowe's depends on customer satisfaction and reputation. Issues with customer experience, service quality or reputation could impact sales and loyalty. (default score, to be refined)
